title: Dying or getting busted in a Ratio Rampage leaves the rampage running: hecklers spawn at the hospital, the player dies again and again, and the hospital weapon loss is undone
repro: Boot file:///home/user/Kannako-Homes/grand-theft-pundit/index.html?headless=1&seed=7&skipTitle=1. Run: p=GTP.game.player; p.weapons={fist:Infinity,pistol:40,shotgun:12}; mk=GTP.Strands.debug.markers().find(m=>m.id==='rr_04'); teleport to (mk.x+20,mk.z), advance 0.3 s, teleport to (mk.x,mk.z), advance until Strands.active()==='ratio_rampages' (0.6 s), then until the countdown ends (3 s). Call p.applyDamage(9999,null,'debug') and advance in 1 s steps for 220 s. Seen twice: rr_04 and rr_02. Script: tests/out/qa_strands_r1/qa_rampage_death.js rr_04 (or rr_02). Bust case: qa_rr08.js (seed 7, $5000, god mode, heckler cars wrecked within 35 m): the player reaches 3 stars and is busted at t=71 s.
expected: Per GDD 5.4 a rampage fails on death. WASTED or BUSTED should end it right away with the CONTEXT STAMPED card, and the normal respawn penalties should apply: weapons lost, cash lost.
actual: Strands.active() is still 'ratio_rampages' after the hospital respawn. The timer keeps running from 118.7 s and new waves spawn around the hospital. On rr_04 the player died 26 times and money fell from $250 to $17. On rr_02 the player died 44 times and money fell to $5, stuck in a WASTED loop for about 2 minutes. When the rampage finally times out, end() puts back the weapons the player had before it (pistol and shotgun), undoing the hospital weapon loss. After the bust, the rampage carried on from the precinct and paid out there.
hint: js/09_missions.js Strands.update runs only in state 'playing' and checks `!p.alive`, but by then Combat.respawnPlayer has already set alive=true. Listen for the 'player:wasted' and 'busted' events (or read Combat.death) and call S.ratio_rampages.finish(false,'dead') or endCurrent('dead') for any active strand.

title: HOA Patrol: pulling over or blocking a flagged car never counts as a stop because C.STRANDS.stopNear is undefined
repro: seed=7 (and seed=11). Spawn a cop car with T_.car('cop') (nearest road point 12 m east) and enter it. Press 'action' and wait for a target (2 s). Then: t=Strands.current().target; GTP.Strands.drivers.release(t); t.setControls(0,0,true,1); advance 2 s. Teleport the player's stopped cop car 7 m behind t and line it up with t.yaw (edge distance 4.75 m). Hold both braked and advance 4 s in 0.1 s steps. Script: tests/out/qa_strands_r1/qa_hoa.js 7 / 11.
expected: GDD 5.2 / section 7: a stop counts when the target is under 1 m/s with the player's car within 6 m for 2 s. The STOPPED bar should fill, then pay $150+50*level and go to the next level.
actual: Current().holdT stays 0, Strands.hud().holdBar is null, and the level stays at 1. GTP.C.STRANDS.stopNear is undefined, so `d <= SK.stopNear + hl` is NaN and always false. The only way to clear a level is to wreck the flagged car.
hint: js/09_missions.js S.hoa_patrol.update (~line 2578) uses SK.stopNear, but SK (C.STRANDS defaults ~line 1861) has no stopNear; it lives on C.MISSIONS as K.stopNear: 6. Add stopNear: 6 to the SK defaults or use K.stopNear.

title: 5 of the 10 stunt jumps cannot be completed (sj_03, sj_05, sj_06, sj_08, sj_10), so the all-ten reward ($5,000, +10k subs, stunt_pundit) can never be earned
repro: Run tests/out/qa_strands_r1/qa_stunts.js. For each ramp in Strands.stunts.list() it spawns a sports car 25, 40 and 60 m behind the ramp along -yawToDir(ramp.yaw), enters it, holds 'forward' and keeps it on the line until the launch. Surface profiles: qa_ramp_profile.js.
expected: Every ramp can be landed with a reasonable straight run-up, as sj_01, 02, 04, 07 and 09 can (ok at 40 m, about 29.8 m/s, about 1.1 s of air).
actual: sj_06 Span Skip: the ramp at (336.4,586) points straight at the toll-gantry leg (craneleg prop at 337,594). The car hits it in the air 8 m out (29.2 to 10.9 m/s, hp 80 to 29), bounces back to about (327,586) and fails 'zone' at every distance on both seeds. sj_08 Hangar Hop: the car flies into the cutout-jet prop (plane at 90,709, r 4.2), because prop collision ignores height, and ends at about (80,711) 'zone'. Parked fleet cars also sit in the landing area. sj_10 Well, Actually: the run-up is a road at y 0.00 and the wedge base is on the sidewalk at 0.12. The car only rises to 0.5 m and drops back, so stunt:launch never fires (15, 25, 40 and 60 m run-ups). The car also always ends up about 0.95 m off the ramp's centreline, and the landing point (752,408) is a cluster of trees and benches that wrecks the car. sj_05 Hedge Fund: on seed 7, trees stand on the ramp foot and run-up (609,215 / 607,213 / 603,211) and the car stops dead at z 212 (25 to 1.3 m/s). On seed 11 it launches but gets only 0.92 to 1.05 s of air against minAir 1.2, and no longer run-up exists (lawn, water, house). sj_03 Assembly Required: the deck is about 16 m wide (z 128 to 144), so a straight run across it peaks at 15.9 m/s and gives 1.17 s of air against minAir 1.6 ('short'). Angled approaches along the leg hit the deck-edge barrier and never launch. Done after all runs: sj_01, 02, 04, 07, 09 only.
hint: 20_content_world.js stuntRamps and 04_world.js prop placement: clear a corridor (no solid props, trees or lamps within about 3 m of the line from -40 m to the landing point plus 14 m) and keep the gantry leg and plane cutout out of the flight path. Make sj_10's wedge base match the road height, or fix World.heightAt's 'mover at or above its base' rule for road-to-kerb ramps. Lower sj_03's minAir or turn the ramp to run along the leg. Lower sj_05's minAir or move the ramp.

title: A rampage gives back the player's own ammo twice, and above the weapon's cap
repro: seed=7: p.weapons.pistol=100; Combat.ammo(p,'pistol'); stand in the rr_02 bubble (from 20 m away, then on it, 0.6 s). After the countdown, kill every heckler with GTP.Combat.damage(h,999,p,'pistol') without firing a shot. Seed 11: tests/out/qa_strands_r1/qa_loaner.js rr_04 100 win and qa_loaner.js rr_02 50 fail. expected: Per GDD 5.4 the player keeps what they had plus the unused loaner: 100 + 60 = 160 pistol rounds, capped at mag+reserve = 132.

title: Rampage loaners are kept even when the rampage fails, far over the caps and before the shop unlock: walking into rr_08 at a new game gives the Ratio Launcher with 72 rockets
repro: New game, seed 7 (and seed 11): stand in the rr_08 bubble for 0.6 s, then teleport 300-400 m away and advance until the rampage times out (about 153 s). area: missions/combat AI (m03_ratio and every melee fight)
title: Melee mission hostiles punch at the full fist rate with no cooldown, so the Act I fist fight in m03 kills a full-health player in 3.5-4.5 s
repro: index.html?headless=1&seed=7&mission=m03_ratio. Win the ratio minigame (press action when meter is in the green). At objective 'Dunk's chat has arrived. Clear the Alley', either (a) give no input, or (b) face the nearest thug with the camera yaw, hold forward+run until within 1.4 m, then hold shoot. Advance in 1/20 s steps. In (a) hp reads 100,100,100,100,78,50,14,0 in 0.5 s samples, with a 'damage' event of 7.2 (src thug:fist) every 0.15-0.2 s. In (b) seeds 7, 11 and 23 all die after 3.5-4.4 s with at most 1 of 4 thugs down. Kiting (sprint away whenever 2 or more are within 3 m) dies after about 7 s with 0 down. Same bot without god mode: m05_peer survive dies at 10.8 s with the table leg, m06_rally survive at 8.5 s with the revolver, m13_thursday survive at 10 s with the SMG (damage logged as protester/thug:fist). Scripts: tests/out/qa_campaign_r1/m03_fight.js, m03_kite.js, dbg_m03dmg.js, fights.js.
expected: m03 is the fifth mission of the 'genuinely easy' Act I on-ramp and should be winnable with fists. Survive waves should last 60-90 s for a careful player. GDD_EXPANSION 6.9 friendlier numbers: AI_DAMAGE_MUL 0.45.
actual: Four thugs each land 12*0.6 = 7.2 per punch at Combat's 2.5/s player fist rate, about 30-70 hp/s in total. The fight is effectively unwinnable. campaign.js only passes these fights with god mode on.
hint: js/09_missions.js hostileTick melee branch (about line 615): it calls CB.fire(p,'fist') every brain tick, limited only by the weapon rate. The ranged branch has an ai.shotT cooldown of 1.2-2.6 s; the melee branch has none. Also js/08_combat.js melee: dmg = w.dmg * (isPlayer ? 1 : 0.6). title: QUIT on the CONTEXT STAMPED card leaves the retry armed; a later death or bust re-offers it with RETRY pre-selected and reverts money and weapons to the old snapshot
repro: ?headless=1&seed=11&mission=m02_read. Enter the mattress truck, then call Q.ctx().vehicle.applyDamage(9999) as a stand-in for wrecking it. When the card is up for more than 0.8 s, press cancel (Backspace) = QUIT; the toast reads 'Back to the marker.' GTP.Missions.canRetry() is still true. Add $5,000 (player.money += 5000) to stand in for later play. Die (player.applyDamage(999)) or get busted. After the hospital or precinct respawn the CONTEXT STAMPED card for 'Read the Read' reappears. Press Enter (RETRY is selected by default): money goes 4748 -> 275, the player is teleported into the old m02 checkpoint in the truck. Reproduced: seeds 11 and 23 (death), seed 7 (bust); also in p11.js (m04 timer fail, QUIT, later bust: card 'Four Minutes: Out of time.') and p2.js 'quit' scenario. Screenshot: tests/out/qa_campaign_r1/p11_card_after_bust.png.
expected: QUIT clears the retry offer (GDD_EXPANSION 6.4: QUIT = abort, back to the marker). An unrelated later death or bust never brings back an old mission's card.
actual: lastFail is never cleared, so canRetry() stays true indefinitely. The stale card appears after every later wasted/busted until a new non-replay mission is started. Accepting it wipes all money and weapons gained since the old checkpoint.
hint: js/11_ui.js retryActivate('quit') calls Ms._dropRetry, but js/09_missions.js never defines _dropRetry. Add Missions._dropRetry = function(){ lastFail = null; } (or clear lastFail in the quit path). Consider also clearing lastFail on a replay start and expiring it after a time.

title: Soft-lock: once the mission-issued ammo for a weapon-restricted objective runs out, the objective can never be completed (no refill, shop locked, no timer)
repro: m09b: ?headless=1&seed=7&mission=m09b_hotmic. Force to the destroy objective (GTP.Missions.completeObjective()). Get out, then throw all 4 hot mics away from the two parked vans (aim held, shoot, wait 3.2 s each). Result: weapon = fist, objective stays at 0/2. Combat.shop.items('ammo') shows ammo_hotmic and hotmic locked with reason 'Hot Mic'. No pickup. Killing a van with any other weapon is WRONG TAKE and respawns it. Mission stays active forever. Same on seed 11 (dbg_mics.js). m12b: ?headless=1&seed=7&mission=m12b_scope. Walk to the causeway goto point and fire the 10 scoped Fact Checker rounds; they hit a hedge or building (see QA-C1-06). Result: 0 rounds, 0/5. ammo_sniper and sniper are locked with reason 'Citation Needed', and the control_tower sniper pickup is gated 'after m12b' (p10.js run twice, dbg_ammo.js).
expected: A mission that requires a specific weapon always lets the player finish it: ammo refills or a nearby ammo crate during the objective, the item unlocked in the shop while the mission runs, or a fail ('out of ammo') that offers RETRY.
actual: The player is stuck in an endless mission. The only exits are ABORT from the phone or dying, and neither is hinted.
hint: js/09_missions.js H.defeat / H.destroy with o.weapon: when the player's ammo for c.weapon reaches 0 with targets left, either top it up (Combat.giveAmmo) or fail with reason 'out_of_ammo'. Alternatively unlock the shop item during the run (Combat.shop locked check against Missions.state.active).

title: Intro cutscene shot 2 puts the camera at the giver's shoulder instead of over the player's shoulder: most intros show a full-frame close-up of a character's back
repro: ?headless=1&seed=7. Call GTP.Missions.prep('m09b_hotmic',{intro:true}), press back once to reach shot 2, advance 1 s, render. Camera is at (735.5,1.72,678.2); the player is at (734.8,680) facing north (fwd 0,-1); the giver Redacted is at (734.8,678). The camera is 0.73 m from the giver, 1.8 m in front of the player. The giver's yaw is 1.57 (facing west, side-on to the player). Same numbers for m02_read and m00_intro (dbg_ots.js). Contact sheets tests/out/qa_campaign_r1/sheet_a.jpg..sheet_c.jpg (shot 2 = second column of each pair) show the close-up back or shoulder in m01b, m02, m03b, m04, m05, m05b, m06, m07, m07b, m08, m08b, m09, m09b, m10, m11, m12b, m13, m13b, m15a and m15b, e.g. cs_m09b_hotmic_2.png.
expected: GDD_EXPANSION 4.3: shot 2 is the reverse shot from the player's shoulder looking at the giver, with the giver facing the player.
actual: The second half of almost every intro (6-15 s with the dialogue) is a wall of one character's back or shoulder; the person speaking cannot be seen.
hint: js/24_content_expansion.js buildIntro shot2: from {entity:'player', offset:{x:0.7, y:1.6, z:-1.8}}. js/12_cutscenes.js fromEntity treats +z as back (x right, z back), so -1.8 is 1.8 m forward. Use z:+1.8 (GDD 4.3's -1.8 contradicts its own 4.1 convention). Also make the giver actor face the player in shot 2: the reused marker giver keeps its own yaw.

title: m05_peer can fail 'spotted' about 3 s after play begins with no player input, because Dr. Footnote spawns 1.5-5 m from the player and walks past them
repro: ?headless=1&seed=7. Call GTP.Missions.prep('m05_peer',{}) then abort(); walk out of and back into the m05 light; hold confirm 0.8 s to skip the intro; read through the lines; then give no input. Distances in 0.5 s samples: 3.5, 2.8, 2.8, 3.6, 4.9 ('Too close' hint the whole time). mission:fail m05_peer/spotted fires 3.0 s after the follow objective starts. Reproduced 3 times on seed 7 (p9.js m05_still and m05_tail, m05_retry.js). On RETRY the courier respawned 1.3 m away. On seeds 3, 11, 23 and 42, and with the intro watched in full, it survives with only about 0.3-0.5 s margin ('Too close' for 2.5-2.9 s of the 3 s allowance). m09_balloon behaves the same (courier spawns 2.7-6.5 m away, 'Too close' for ~3 s).
expected: A tail starts with the target well ahead (at least followTooClose plus a margin), and the spotted timer only runs after the player has had a chance to react.
actual: The fail window is open from frame one. A player reading the objective text, or RESTART MISSION (which skips the intro), gets CONTEXT STAMPED before moving.
hint: js/09_missions.js H.follow.start: randomSpot(at, 1.5, 5) with at = the giver door, which is where the player stands. Spawn 12+ m along the route, or start c.closeT counting only after about 4 s or once the distance first exceeds followTooClose. K.followTooClose 6 / followCloseTime 3.

title: m12b: from the causeway railing the mission sends you to, most of the five couriers are hidden behind island buildings and hedges
repro: ?headless=1&mission=m12b_scope. Force the goto (completeObjective) so the couriers spawn. From the goto point (634,270) and points 10-20 m either side along the causeway, raycastBuildings from eye height to each courier's chest is blocked for 4/5 (seed 7), 5/5 (seed 11) and 4/5 (seed 23). Distances are 99-160 m, several beyond or at the Fact Checker's 160 m range (dbg_los.js). Through the scope (dbg_snipe.png) the crosshair on courier 1 sits on a hedge; the trace hits a building at (600,1.6,221.6), RANGE reads 63 m, and 10 shots hit nothing.
expected: GDD_EXPANSION m12b: cite the five couriers from the causeway railing with the long rifle; that is the range lesson.
actual: The core mechanic does not work from the designated spot. Players burn the 10 rounds on hedges, which leads to the QA-C1-03 soft-lock, or must cross onto the island under fire.
hint: js/24_content_expansion.js m12b defeat spawn (around goldplate_links, radius 200) and/or the goto point (causeway_east). Spawn the couriers at points with verified line of sight (raycastBuildings) from the railing, within 120 m.

title: First-ever NEW GAME (no saves) skips the opening cutscene and the h_move/h_look hints; the player stands in an un-armed blue light with no guidance
repro: Non-headless: index.html?seed=7&skipTitle=0&mute=1. Clear localStorage; on the title press Enter (NEW GAME). After loading, state is 'playing': no cs_opening (flags.cs_cs_opening false, no cutscene:start), no 'hint' event within 13 s idle, activeSlot 1. The player spawns inside the m00 light, which does not arm until the player has left it, and nothing on screen says so (p1_newgame.png). Reproduced in all 3 p1.js runs.
expected: GDD_EXPANSION 4.1: cs_opening plays on New Game after the loading screen. 6.6: h_move fires when the opening ends, then h_look. A first-time player is the main audience for both.
actual: Only players who already have a save (the slot-picker path) ever see the opening and the movement and look hints. The first session starts cold.
hint: js/11_ui.js: FAST_START_OPENING = false, and titleActivate's no-save path beginNewGame(1, g.seed, FAST_START_OPENING). Pass opening:true, or fire h_move/h_look from Game when no opening plays. Optionally show 'Step into the blue light' when spawning inside the first marker.

area: UI prompts: Escape in cutscenes and on the retry card
title: On-screen prompts promise 'ESC skips the shot' and 'ESC quit', but Escape opens the pause menu
repro: Non-headless ?mission=m02_read&intro=1&skipTitle=1 with real keyboard. (1) During the intro the pill reads 'ESC skips the shot'. Press Escape: state becomes 'paused' (PAUSED menu), the shot does not change. Press Escape again: the game resumes and the shot is skipped at the same time. (2) Wreck the truck. The CONTEXT STAMPED card reads 'ENTER choose · ESC quit'. Press Escape: the PAUSED menu opens over the card (p4_card_escape.png). Only Backspace quits. Reproduced twice (p4.js twice, p11.js).
expected: Escape does what the prompt says (skip the shot / QUIT), or the prompts name the key that does (S/Backspace).
actual: UI.handleInput checks pressed('pause') before the cutscene skip and before retryInput; Escape is bound to pause+back+cancel, so the pause menu wins.
hint: js/11_ui.js handleInput 'cutscene' and 'playing' cases: when a cutscene is skippable, or a failed card with a retry offer is up, consume Escape as back/cancel before openPause. Otherwise change GLYPH.keyboard.cancel and the pill text to BACKSPACE.

title: REPLAY from the phone never plays the mission's intro cutscene
repro: Non-headless ?mission=m00_intro (or m04_hit), real keys. Complete the mission. Press M, Tab to REPLAY (or MISSIONS), select the completed row, press Enter. Within 0.1 s: state 'playing', phase 'play', Cutscenes.active false, banner 'Table Stakes / REPLAY', objective 'Get to Dorm 4B'. The intro is skipped. Reproduced via the REPLAY tab (p5.js) and the MISSIONS tab (p11.js, m04). Calling GTP.Missions.replay() directly from 'playing' does play the intro.
expected: GDD_EXPANSION 6.5: REPLAY starts the mission with {replay:true} and the intro cutscene plays.
actual: missionRowActivate calls Ms.replay(id) while Game state is 'paused'. Missions.start sees g.state !== 'playing' and calls beginPlay() instead of playIntro().
hint: js/11_ui.js missionRowActivate: closePause() before Ms.replay(r.id), or have Missions.start treat 'paused' like 'playing' when deciding to play the intro (js/09_missions.js start).

title: Reaching a goto objective in a vehicle never completes it and gives no 'get out' hint
repro: ?headless=1&mission=m13b_ratio. Force to the last objective 'Get back to the garage' (a 790 m leg players will drive). Get in a sedan and stop 1 m from the target light. After 5 s: objective unchanged, Missions.state.hint null, no HUD hint. Pressing F (exit) completes it immediately. Same with m15b 'Walk back to the Quad' (dbg_gotocar.js).
expected: Either complete on arrival, or show a hint such as 'Get out of the car' while in a vehicle in the light (drive_to already has a 'Get back in the ...' hint).
actual: The player sits in the light and nothing happens.
hint: js/09_missions.js H.goto: add a hint(o,c,p) that returns 'Get out on foot' when p.inVehicle and within radius, or relax the on-foot rule for the long return legs.

title: Ending A leaves the player on the roof of Goldplate Tower after the credits; they walk off and drop 37 m
repro: ?headless=1&mission=m15a_primetime. Finish it (ratio minigame won). cs_ending_a plays, then the credits; press confirm. Player is at (338,254) with y 37 to 25 (falling), ground 0.1; walking forward lands at y 0.1. The same y after skipping cs_ending_a in p3.js (y 34.2). Seen in p7.js and p3.js; frame p7_A_after.png.
expected: After the ending cutscene the player is back at street level (the tower door or where they were).
actual: The 'player' actor placed with roof:true is never put back, so the game resumes with the player at the roof edge and falling.
hint: js/12_cutscenes.js finish(): restore the player's pre-cutscene position when the script repositioned the player (store it in play()), at least when the actor spot was roof:true.

area: cutscenes: ending B and act cutscenes
title: Ending B ignores its dawn clock and opens with the camera inside a tree; MISSION PASSED card overlaps the start of act and ending cutscenes
repro: ?headless=1&mission=m15a_primetime, complete it, then start and finish m15b_liveread (p7.js). cs_ending_b plays at clock 18.4 (dusk), although the script has clock: 6.4; js/12_cutscenes.js never reads 'clock'. In shot 1 at t = 1-3 s the left half of the frame is a tree canopy (act_cs_ending_b_1.png, p7_B_1.png). For both endings the 'MISSION PASSED' card is still drawn over the letterboxed cinematic for its first ~2 s (p7_A_1.png, p7_B_1.png; the cutscene starts 2.6 s into the 4.8 s card).
expected: GDD_EXPANSION 4.2: Founders' Quad at dawn (clock 6.4). Unobstructed establishing shot. Card gone or hidden when a letterboxed cutscene starts.
actual: Dusk lighting, a tree occluding the opening frames, and the card overlapping the shot.
hint: js/12_cutscenes.js play(): honour script.clock (set GTP.game.time.clock, restore after). Nudge the cs_ending_b shot 1 from-point in js/24_content_expansion.js. js/11_ui.js: drop ui.card when state becomes 'cutscene', or raise cutsceneAfterDelay above the card length.

title: Mission unlock ammo differs from GDD_EXPANSION 2.1: rifle +60 (GDD 90) and launcher +4 (GDD 3)
repro: ?headless=1&mission=m08b_jets; force all objectives and finish. Toast 'Unlocked: The Monologue (+60)', player.weapons.rifle = 60. ?mission=m13b_ratio the same way: toast 'Unlocked: Ratio Launcher (+4)'. GTP.Missions.K.weaponAmmo = {rifle:60, ratio:4, ...} (dbg_unlock.js, dump.js).
expected: GDD_EXPANSION 2.1 shared rules: C.MISSIONS.weaponAmmo gains rifle: 90, ratio: 3 (revolver 24, sniper 10, hotmic 4 match).
actual: rifle 60, ratio 4.
hint: C.MISSIONS.weaponAmmo in js/01_config.js (or the defaults in js/09_missions.js K): set rifle 90 and ratio 3, or update the GDD if the change was deliberate.

title: The h_save hint ('Sitting in it here saves the game') first fires during m01b, when sitting in the van cannot save
repro: Fresh game (p1.js). Complete m00 and m01 with real inputs, then walk into the m01b light and enter the pod van, which is the mission's first objective. The hint event 'h_save' fires at that moment while the mission is active, as in both p1.js runs that reached m01b. Autosave never runs during a mission, and hints are once per save, so the hint is never shown when it is true.
expected: h_save fires the first time the player enters the pod van at the garage outside a mission (GDD_EXPANSION 6.6), when doing so actually saves.
actual: Shown mid-mission; nothing saves.
hint: js/12_cutscenes.js Hints / the home-van trigger in js/30_game.js: only fire h_save when !Missions.state.active and the autosave conditions hold.

title: Drive objectives' 'get back in' hint prints raw vehicle class ids ('Get back in the suv', 'Get back in the bike')
repro: ?headless=1&mission=m10_pellets: enter the pellet SUV, get out during 'Deliver the pellets to the HOA Hall'; Missions.state.hint = 'Get back in the suv'. In m08_scooters the hint reads 'Get back in the bike' (p8.js audit).
expected: Readable copy: 'Get back in the SUV', 'Get back on the scooter'.
actual: The lower-case internal class name, with the wrong preposition for bikes.
hint: js/09_missions.js H.drive_to.hint, H.deliver_passenger.hint and H.stunt.hint: map the class to a display name (bike -> 'on the scooter' or 'bike', suv -> 'SUV').

title: A direct rocket hit on a Ratio Launcher target van counts as WRONG TAKE, so m13b cannot be won the intended way
repro: Boot index.html?headless=1&seed=7&skipTitle=1&mission=m13b_ratio. Step through the intro (Input.set('confirm') taps) until Missions.current().def.type === 'destroy'. Pick a van from Missions.current().ctx.vehicles and stop it (v.vx = v.vz = 0). Teleport 14 m behind it, then set Render.rig.yaw to face it with pitch 0.12. Hold aim for 0.2 s (it locks the van), tap shoot, then advance 1.7 s. Script: tests/out/qa_combat_r1/t16.js. Reproduced on 2 vans in each of 2 fresh boots.
expected: The rocket wrecks the van and the destroy objective counts it (weapon:'ratio').
actual: The van explodes with only a vehicle:exploded event and no vehicle:damage event. v._lastHit and v._igniteHit stay null, so the check marks v._wrong = true (WRONG TAKE), ctx.wrong goes up and a substitute van spawns. Only splash hits are credited. The lock-on centres the rocket on the van, which makes a direct hit, and so a WRONG TAKE, the normal result.
hint: js/08_combat.js areaBlast: `if (rocket && e === direct) { e.lastDamageSrc = owner; e.explode(owner); }` never calls applyDamage, so 09_missions.js's 'vehicle:damage' listener never records the hit. Call e.applyDamage(e.hp + 1, owner, 'ratio') before explode() (or emit vehicle:damage with type 'ratio'), or have the Missions 'vehicle:exploded' listener fill _igniteHit when it is missing. tests/campaign.js hides this because it calls applyDamage(..., 'ratio') after the aimed shot.

title: Buying ammo for a weapon you don't own gives you the weapon: the $7,500 launcher for $600, the $4,500 sniper for $250
repro: Boot seed=7 (headless). Run: GTP.Missions.state.completed.add('m13_thursday'); add 'm12b_scope' the same way. Then p.weapons = {fist: Infinity}; p.money = 2000; GTP.Combat.shop.buy('ammo_ratio'); GTP.Combat.shop.buy('ammo_sniper'). The UI's BUY button calls the same shop.buy, and shop.items('ammo') reports canBuy: true. Reproduced twice (t2.js, confirm.js).
expected: Ammo needs the weapon. Refuse with something like 'Buy the weapon first' and grey the row.
actual: Both buys return ok. The player now owns 'ratio' (1 rocket) and 'sniper' (5 rounds), is switched to the launcher, and has spent $850 in total. The WEAPONS tab then lists the launcher as OWNED.
hint: js/08_combat.js shop.buy ammo branch -> giveAmmo(p, id, n, true) creates the weapon. items() canBuy for tab 'ammo' does not check p.weapons[it.weapon] > 0.

title: The hot mic ignores its fire rate: tapping fire throws all 8 mics in one second
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Teleport to (578,214), yaw -PI/2. Run p.weapons = {fist: Infinity}; GTP.game.debug.giveWeapon('hotmic', 8); advance 2 s. Then 30 times: Input.set('shoot', true); advance 1/60; Input.set('shoot', false); advance 1/60. Fast real mouse clicks take the same path. Script: t1.js section A and confirm.js.
expected: At rate 0.8/s, at most 1 or 2 mics leave the hand in 1 s (the hot take correctly throws 1 in the same test).
actual: All 8 mics are thrown within 1.0 s (8 blasts of 60, or 180 against vehicles), which trivialises any fight or destroy objective.
hint: js/08_combat.js Combat.fire: `if (isPlayer && id === 'hotmic' && ped.weapons[id] > 0) { if (!ped._cook) startCook(ped, id); return false; }` runs before the `_fireT` cadence check, and tickCook's release lob never checks the cadence. Move the cadence check above startCook, or gate startCook on now - _fireT >= 1/rate.

title: The first gunshot of a session freezes the game while every lit material recompiles (the muzzle light is added lazily)
repro: Boot seed=7 (normal, headless=0, skipTitle=1). Give a pistol and record rAF frame times. Tap shoot once. Headless version: render 3 frames, read renderer.info.programs.length, tap shoot, time one GTP.game.render(). Scripts t17.js and confirm.js; reproduced 4 times.
expected: No hitch. ARCHITECTURE says Render.muzzleLight 'stays resident at intensity 0 between shots (adding a light recompiles every material)'.
actual: Shader programs go 31 -> 45 on the first shot (21 -> 35 headless). The frame after the first shot takes 3.46 s under SwiftShader (5.06 s and 843 ms in the headless runs, against about 13 ms normally). On a real GPU this is a visible stall at the first gunfight.
hint: js/08_combat.js muzzleLight(): `if (!L) { L = Rd.muzzleLight = new THREE.PointLight(...); Rd.scene.add(L); }` runs on the first player shot. Create the light during Render scene setup (js/10_render.js, intensity 0) so the light count never changes.

title: Aim lock-on takes over the shot: aiming at a parked van shoots a civilian standing 17° off the crosshair
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Teleport to (578,214), rig yaw -PI/2, pitch 0.12, pistol. Spawn a parked van at (+8, +0.7) and a civilian at (+10, -3.2) (T_.freeze). Hold aim 0.4 s, then fire 3 single shots 0.35 s apart. Screenshot: tests/out/qa_combat_r1/N1_lock_hijack.png. Scripts t6.js N1 and confirm.js.
expected: The shots hit what the screen centre rests on (the van), or the lock goes to what the player is pointing at.
actual: The lock goes to the civilian and the crosshair jumps onto him (half hidden behind the player's head). The van takes 0 damage, the civilian takes 54, and the player gets 1 star. The lock stays until the camera swings more than about 43° (lockValid 0.75 rad), so you cannot free-aim at cars, the ground or a different ped while any ped is in the 40° cone. The launcher also locks any driven car up to 120 m away.
hint: js/08_combat.js updateAim / aimContext: `if (cur) { if (cp.entity === cur) pt = cp; else pt = chest of cur }`. Prefer cp.entity when the camera ray rests on a valid entity, drop the lock when the ray drifts more than a few degrees from it, and/or do not auto-acquire non-hostile civilians.

title: Dismissing the last dialogue line with a click or E also fires the held gun (and can earn a star)
repro: Boot seed=7 headless and give a pistol. Call GTP.Missions.say([{who:'gus', text:'Only line.'}]) and advance 0.6 s (state 'cutscene'). Do a real page.mouse.down/up at (640,360), or a real KeyE down/up, across one step, then advance 0.3 s. Variant: put a cop 8 m away first. Scripts t18.js (real input), t3.js I, t6.js I2, confirm.js.
expected: The input that closes the dialogue is used up. No shot until the button is released and pressed again.
actual: stats.shots +1 and the magazine goes 12 -> 11 on the dismiss frame, for both the mouse click and E. With a cop nearby the stray shot raises wanted to 1 star (heat 2). This can happen on every mission intro and outro.
hint: js/30_game.js step(): _handleGlobalInput -> UI.handleInput('cutscene') -> advanceDialogue -> Missions endDialogue sets the state to 'playing' inside the same step, then player.control reads In.down('shoot'/'action'). Latch fire until the buttons are released after a state change (e.g. a p.fireLatch flag), or skip player.control on the step whose state changed.

title: You can only look about 10-12° up: the sniper scope can never see the 5-star helicopter, and an SMG lock on it puts crosshair and reticle off-screen
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. With the sniper, hold aim (scope) and push Input.setLook(0,-80) for 1 s, then read Render.camera.getWorldDirection elevation: 9.7°. Over the shoulder (pistol): 11.9°. Chase cam: 11.3°. Then debug.setWanted(5) and keep it there until AI.police.heli orbits (24 m radius, 30 m up, 49.4° above the eye). Scope while facing it at pitchMin: aim.hover is the heli in 0 of 120 frames. With the SMG plus aim, the heli locks but aim.screen.sy = -222 and targetScreen.visible = false. Screenshot qa_combat_r1/heli_locked_offscreen.png shows empty sky, no reticle. Scripts t1.js B, t7.js S, t8.js S2, confirm.js.
expected: GDD_EXPANSION §2.1: the Fact Checker reaches 'the helicopter at full range'. The player should be able to look at and see what they are shooting overhead (rooftops, the heli).
actual: CAMERA.pitchMin is -20°, and the first-person focus math (fy = desired.y - sin(pitch)*3 over 6 m) turns that into only 9.7° in the scope. The orbiting heli is always about 49° up, so the scope can never reach it. The lock-on fights against a target the player cannot see.
hint: js/01_config.js CAMERA.pitchMin, and js/10_render.js rig.update ('first' and aiming focus: use a real yaw/pitch direction, e.g. tan(pitch), and a much higher look-up limit while aiming/scoped).

title: Walking over any weapon pickup (e.g. the gun a cop drops) switches your held weapon and ignores the ammo cap
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Teleport to (578,214) facing east. Give pistol 132 (the 12 + 120 cap) and smg 60, and equip the smg. Call GTP.Combat.spawnPickup({type:'weapon', weaponId:'pistol', ammo:12, x:p.x+1.5, z:p.z}). Hold forward 0.6 s. Scripts t1.js D and confirm.js.
expected: Rounds are added up to the cap (mag + reserve). The held weapon stays unless the player had fists or did not own that gun (GTA-style).
actual: p.weapon becomes 'pistol' (from the SMG) and any reload is cancelled. Pistol ammo becomes 144, above the 132 cap. Cops drop guns at their body half the time, so a close-range kill in a 3-star fight swaps your gun mid-fight. World crates respawn every 180 s and stack without limit.
hint: js/08_combat.js collectPickup: `p.weapons[id] = (p.weapons[id] || 0) + n; ... p.weapon = id; cancelReload(p)`. Use giveAmmo(p, id, n, true), and only switch when the weapon is new or the player has fists.

title: The police helicopter never shoots (GDD §2.3: its gunner uses the SMG)
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Teleport to (578,214) and give the player very high hp. Call debug.setWanted(5) and hold it there for 30 s. Each 0.5 s, destroy peds and cars within 120 m so only the heli is left, and log GTP.Events 'damage' on the player. Script t2.js G.
expected: At 5 stars the helicopter's gunner fires SMG bursts at a player it can see (at AI damage scaling).
actual: The heli was within 40 m for 54 of 60 samples and h.sees was true for 52, yet there were zero damage events on the player. Heli.update in 07_ai.js has no firing code. At 5 stars, the air unit only spots the player.
hint: js/07_ai.js class Heli update(): add a gunner (e.g. Combat.fire from a muzzle under the heli with weapon 'smg', or a simple hitscan with AI_DAMAGE_MUL) when this.sees and within range.

title: m12b couriers never shoot back, and 2 of the 5 cannot be seen from anywhere on the causeway
repro: Boot index.html?headless=1&seed=7&skipTitle=1&mission=m12b_scope. Confirm through the intro, teleport to causeway_east's door and wait for the defeat objective. Measure from the player to Missions.current().ctx.peds and run 20 s with godMode on. Scripts t13.js and t14.js (samples sightlines from every bridge tile within 70 m).
expected: Per GDD and the objective text ('before they cite you'; 'they empty [pistols] at anything on the causeway from a hundred metres away, badly'), the couriers fire back, and all five can be cited from the railing.
actual: The couriers stand 112-143 m away holding pistols (range 35). The stationary hostileTick branch only fires when d <= weapon range, so in 20 s they never fire (0 damage events, _fireT unchanged). From the door only 1 of 5 has a clear line at eye height. At best 3 are visible at once from any causeway point, and 2 are never visible.
hint: js/09_missions.js hostileTick stationary branch (`if (d <= rng && ...)`): allow a mission-level long range (e.g. spawn.fireRange with extra spread). Also check the courier spawn points in js/24_content_expansion.js m12b against sightlines from causeway_east.

title: Explosive kills (hot take, hot mic, rocket) give no hit marker, no kill confirm and no kill stat
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. For each weapon in Combat.ORDER, set up a thug with 10 hp at the weapon's range (t15.js) and listen for 'hitmarker' events and Audio.counts.confirm. Compare stats.kills.
expected: GDD §2.2: 'On any hit, the crosshair's four ticks flare...; on a kill the ticks turn pink, draw an X and play confirm'.
actual: Every gun and melee weapon gives hitmarker + kill + confirm + stats.kills +1. hottake, hotmic and ratio kill the ped but give 0 hitmarker events, no confirm sound and stats.kills +0.
hint: js/08_combat.js takeBlast / areaBlast never call markHit or bump stats.kills for player-owned blasts.

title: Cooking a hot mic shows no fuse outside aim mode; in a car, holding fire blows it up inside your own car and starts another cook
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Give hotmic 4, enter a sedan, then hold shoot for 2.6 s and release. Check Combat.hud().cook and Combat.aim.active at 1 s. Script t15.js V (also t3.js J: cook on foot, then enter a car).
expected: A visible fuse whenever a mic is cooking (on foot from the hip and in a car), and no surprise second cook.
actual: hud().cook runs (k 0.39 at 1 s), but aim.active is false, so UI.drawAimOverlay (the only place the fuse bar is drawn) draws nothing. In a car the held mic mesh is hidden too. At 2.5 s the mic goes off inside the car (sedan burning, hp -80, player still in it). Because the button is still held, playerTick starts a second cook, so 2 mics are spent.
hint: js/11_ui.js drawAimOverlay is the only place that draws hud.cook. Draw it in drawWeapon or at screen centre regardless of aim. js/08_combat.js playerTick in-car lobbed branch: do not re-cook until shoot is released.

title: Recoil while looking fully up pushes the view down (the clamped kick is still 'recovered' in full)
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Give the revolver, hold aim and set Render.rig.pitch = C.CAMERA.pitchMin. Fire 6 shots 0.7 s apart and advance 0.5 s. Compare rig.pitch. SMG: hold fire 2.5 s at pitchMin. Scripts t1.js C and confirm.js.
expected: The view comes back to where it was.
actual: After a cylinder the view has drifted 2.39° downward (SMG burst: 0.36°). Any shooting at the top of the pitch range (rooftops, the heli) pulls the aim down.
hint: js/10_render.js rig.kick: `r.pitch = Math.max(pitchMin, r.pitch - kp); r.kickP += kp` should add only the pitch actually applied after the clamp.

title: Stats page: 'Head shots' is never counted, and 'Shots / hits' counts shotgun pellets (2 shots / 12 hits)
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Land a confirmed pistol head shot (a hitmarker event with zone 'head'), then read p.stats.headshots. Separately, reset stats.shots and stats.hits, then fire 2 shotgun volleys into a thug 4 m away. Scripts t2.js H, t1.js E, confirm.js.
expected: Head shots increments on head hits. Hits are counted per shot (or shots per pellet), so hits never exceed shots.
actual: stats.headshots stays undefined, so the phone STATS row always shows 0. After 2 volleys stats reads shots 2 / hits 12. Melee hits also count as hits without being counted as shots.
hint: js/08_combat.js markHit / hitEntity: add stats.headshots++ for zone 'head' and count one hit per volley. The UI row is in js/11_ui.js drawPhoneStats.

title: The $1,100 shotgun is the slowest gun to kill a standard ped, even at its own close range
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. For each gun, spawn a 60-hp thug 6 m east, hold aim (lock) plus shoot, and time until the ped dies. Script t3.js TTK.
expected: Each gun has a niche. The shotgun should dominate up close.
actual: Time to kill: rifle 0.38 s, SMG 0.62, revolver 0.65, pistol ($450) 0.77, shotgun 0.93. At 45 per volley against 60-hp peds it always needs 2 volleys, even point-blank, so its only edge is the knockdown.
hint: js/08_combat.js WEAPONS.shotgun dmg 45 (a GDD number). Consider about 66-72 per volley, or closer pellet grouping under 5 m.

title: Table leg: two hits leave a 60-hp ped on 4 hp, and the second hit's TABLE FLIP throws them about 4 m out of reach
repro: Boot seed=7 headless. Give the tableleg and spawn a 60-hp thug 1.4 m east (frozen). Hold shoot without moving and log damage events and distance. Script t4.js M.
expected: The $150 melee upgrade kills faster than fists.
actual: Hit 1 (28) leaves 32 hp, which is below 1.5x the damage, so the ped is knocked down. Hit 2 (28, a FLIP) leaves 4 hp and slides the ped to about 4 m, past the 2.8 m reach, while the swings keep missing. From a standing spot it took 7.6 s against fists' 1.6 s. The table leg always needs a chase for the third hit.
hint: js/08_combat.js melee(): tableleg dmg 28 vs PED hp 60. Use 30+ damage, or skip the flip slide when the hit leaves the victim below one more hit.
